借着下坠的缓冲，许默顺势一个战术翻滚卸去余力，右臂肌肉猛然暴起。

漆黑冰冷的战刃在夜色中划出一道惊心动魄的死亡弧线。

噗嗤一声闷响，一颗长满杂毛的头颅冲天而起，腥臭的黑血如同喷泉般溅了许默满脸。

高台之上的方芸眼眶通红，咬紧的嘴唇早已渗出鲜血。

弓弦震颤的嗡嗡声连成了一片密集的死亡急雨，她几乎将拉弓的速度逼到了肌肉撕裂的极限。

裹挟着致命毒液的石箭精准无比地没入下方怪物的躯体，每一支箭矢的落下，必然伴随着一头怪物凄厉的哀嚎。

毒液在它们体内疯狂肆虐，中箭的畜生口吐白沫，庞大的身躯在地上剧烈抽搐几下便彻底失去了生机。

浓郁的血腥味犹如兴奋剂，彻底引爆了怪物的疯狂。

又有一只怪物从燃烧的缺口处贴地窜入，悄无声息地试图从地下偷袭许默的后跟腱！

许默左臂肌肉紧绷，粗糙厚重的厚木盾牌猛地向地面狠狠砸去。

一声闷响。

盾牌边缘精准地磕在那畜生探出的头颅上，巨大的冲击力将其颅骨震得凹陷碎裂。腥臭的脑浆混着黑血溅了一地，那怪物的身体抽搐了两下便没了动静。

可这群迷雾怪根本杀不完！

视线尽头，越来越多的怪物正踩着同伴的焦尸往里挤，原本勉强维持的火圈防线眼看就要彻底崩盘。

许默猛地甩掉战刃上的碎肉，仰起头冲着高台发出一声声嘶力竭的狂吼。

“用能量箭！快！”

方芸眼神一凛，手指扣紧弓弦。

弓臂上暗黑色的纹理骤然亮起幽蓝色的光芒！

无需实体箭矢，每三小时自动凝聚一根穿甲能量箭。

三小时，一次机会。

她猛地松开手指。

一道刺目的蓝白色光矢撕裂夜空，带着尖锐的破空声直直贯入怪物最密集的区域！

“轰——！”

能量箭矢在怪物群中炸开，冲击波裹挟着碎肉与黑血向四周横扫，硬生生清出了一小片空地。

方芸没有丝毫犹豫，反手又从脚下的物资箱里抱起所有陶罐，用尽全身力气朝着高台下方最密集的怪物群掷去。

赤红的火舌贪婪地吞噬着周围的一切，硬生生将火圈向外推出了五六米。

就在许默专注于正面厮杀时，一阵诡异的摩擦声从头顶传来。

Taking advantage of the cushion of his fall, Xu Mo made a tactical roll to release his remaining strength, and the muscles in his right arm suddenly bulged.

The dark and cold war blade drew a thrilling arc of death in the night.

With a muffled sound, a head covered with hair rose into the sky, and the smelly black blood splashed all over Xu Mo's face like a fountain.

Fang Yun's eyes on the high platform were red, and blood was already oozing from her clenched lips.

The trembling buzz of the bow string became a dense rain of death, and she almost pushed the speed of drawing the bow to the limit of muscle tearing.

The stone arrows filled with deadly venom sank into the body of the monster below with incomparable precision. Every arrow falling was inevitably accompanied by a monster's shrill wail.

The venom raged wildly in their bodies, and the beasts hit by the arrows foamed at the mouth. Their huge bodies twitched violently on the ground for a few times before completely losing their vitality.

The strong smell of blood was like a stimulant, completely detonating the monster's madness.

Another monster rushed in from the burning gap, silently trying to attack Xu Mo's Achilles tendon from the ground!

The muscles in Xu Mo's left arm tensed up, and the rough and thick wooden shield suddenly hit the ground.

There was a muffled sound.

The edge of the shield hit the beast's protruding head accurately, and the huge impact made its skull dent and shatter.The smelly brain mixed with black blood splashed all over the floor. The monster's body twitched twice and then stopped moving.

But there is no way to kill all these fog monsters!

At the end of the line of sight, more and more monsters were stepping on the charred corpses of their companions and squeezing in. The fire ring defense line that had been barely maintained was about to completely collapse.

Xu Mo shook off the pieces of meat from the war blade, raised his head and roared at the top of his lungs.

"Use energy arrows! Quick!"

Fang Yun's eyes flashed, and she tightened her fingers on the bow string.

The dark black texture on the bow arm suddenly lit up with a faint blue light!

No need for physical arrows, it automatically condenses an armor-piercing energy arrow every three hours.

Three hours, one chance.

She jerked her fingers away.

A dazzling blue-white light arrow tore through the night sky, with a sharp sound of breaking through the air, and penetrated directly into the area where the monsters were densest!

"Boom——!"

The energy arrows exploded among the monsters, and the shock wave carried the minced meat and black blood and swept across the surroundings, forcibly clearing a small open space.

Without any hesitation, Fang Yun picked up all the clay pots from the supply box at her feet and threw them with all her strength towards the densest group of monsters below the high platform.

The red tongue of fire greedily devoured everything around it, forcefully pushing the fire ring outward five or six meters.

Just when Xu Mo was focusing on the frontal fight, a strange friction sound came from above his head.
